shell.accessOnlyBody: This area is for store administrators. Sign in with an admin account to continue.

error.title: This admin screen could not load
error.body: Something went wrong at our end. Nothing you were viewing has been changed.
error.notFoundTitle: This admin page does not exist
error.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the page may have been renamed.

dashboard.storesOpen: {open} of {active} active stores are open right now
dashboard.noStoreOpen: No store is inside its opening hours right now
dashboard.paused: Ordering is paused platform-wide. No customer can place an order.
dashboard.revenueNote: Revenue counts orders that were placed and not cancelled, rejected or failed, at the totals they were charged.

orders.title: Orders
orders.searchPlaceholder: Order number, or customer name or phone
orders.emptyFiltered: Try a different status, store or search term.
orders.emptyNone: Orders will appear here as customers place them.
orders.caption: Orders across every store, newest first. Each row links to the full order.

orderDetail.notFoundBody: This order no longer exists, or the link is wrong.
orderDetail.cashNote: Cash is recorded as collected when the order is handed over.

override.title: Override {order}
override.description: Use this only when the store cannot act themselves. The customer sees your reason in their order timeline.
override.statusHint: Only the steps this order can legally move to are listed.
override.reasonHint: Recorded against your account and shown to the customer.
override.reasonPlaceholder: For example: store phone is down, confirming on their behalf
override.errReason: Say why you are doing this
override.errStatus: Choose the status to move this order to

customers.title: Customers
customers.emptyFiltered: Try a different name, phone number or status.
customers.emptyNone: Customers appear here as soon as they register.
customers.caption: Registered customers, newest first. Each row links to that customer.
customers.ordersNote: Counts orders that were placed and not cancelled, rejected or failed, at the totals they were charged.
customers.notFoundBody: This account no longer exists, or the link is wrong.

managers.title: Store managers
managers.whoRuns: Who runs each store day to day
managers.emptyBody: A store manager runs one store: its order queue, its stock and what it has available.
managers.caption: Store manager accounts and the store each one runs.

managerDialog.editDesc: Moving them to another store signs them out of the old one immediately.
managerDialog.addDesc: They will sign in with this phone number and password.
managerDialog.phoneHintEdit: The sign-in number cannot be changed here.
managerDialog.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
managerDialog.storeHint: They will only ever see this store's orders and stock.
managerDialog.errPhone: Enter a valid Pakistani mobile number, for example 03001234567
managerDialog.errPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number
managerDialog.errStore: Choose the store they will run

stores.title: Stores
stores.emptyBody: A store is the scope everything else hangs off: its catalogue, its stock, its orders.
stores.openWhenActive: Open whenever the store is active

storeDialog.description: The coordinates are used to price every delivery from this store.
storeDialog.name: Store name
storeDialog.tradingHint: An inactive store takes no orders and is hidden from shoppers.
storeDialog.errPhone: Enter a valid Pakistani mobile number
storeDialog.errHours: A closing time must come after its opening time

settings.title: Settings
settings.tradingDesc: Whether FreshCarts is taking orders at all, and how far it will deliver.
settings.acceptingHint: Turning this off stops every new order across the platform, whatever a store's opening hours say. Orders already placed are unaffected.
settings.maxDistanceHint: Beyond this, delivery is refused and the shopper is offered pickup. Orders already placed keep the distance and fee they were charged.
settings.stockSupportDesc: Defaults for new products, and how shoppers reach you when something goes wrong.
settings.thresholdHint: Applied to new products only. Products already in the catalogue keep the threshold they have.
settings.supportPhoneHint: Shown to shoppers on error and order screens. Never a personal number.
settings.deploymentDesc: Set by the environment this API runs in. Changing any of these needs a redeploy, not a form.
settings.estimateNote: Distances are approximated from a straight line. The API refuses to start in production with this provider, because an approximate distance becomes a real charge.
settings.errMaxKm: Enter a radius between 0.5 km and 100 km
settings.errThreshold: Enter a whole number of units
settings.errPhone: Enter a valid Pakistani mobile number

products.title: Products
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, brand or item code
products.noneYet: No products yet. Create the first one to start selling.

productForm.productDesc: What a shopper sees on the card and page.
productForm.name: Name
productForm.brandHint: Optional — leave blank for unbranded items like loose vegetables.
productForm.shortDescriptionHint: One line, shown on the product card.
productForm.placementDesc: Where this product is found in the store. Type a new name to add a category.
productForm.categoryPlaceholder: Search, or type a new category
productForm.subcategoryHint: Optional, but it makes the product much easier to find.
productForm.subcategoryPlaceholder: Search, or type a new one
productForm.subcategoryEmptyNew: This category is new, so it has no subcategories yet — type one to create it too.
productForm.subcategoryEmptyNone: This category has no subcategories yet. Type a name to create one.
productForm.photosDesc: The first photo is what shoppers see on the product card.
productForm.photoNeedsDescription: Every photo needs a short description.
productForm.priceDesc: Whole rupees. There is no paisa in this catalogue.
productForm.wasPriceHint: Optional. Shown struck through — leave blank when there is no discount.
productForm.sizeHint: 1 for a 1 L bottle, 500 for a 500 g pack, 5 for a 5 kg bag.
productForm.identifiersDesc: Used by staff and, later, by scanning.
productForm.skuHint: Unique within this store. Letters, digits and hyphens.
productForm.barcodeHint: Optional — many local products do not have one.
productForm.alsoFindableHint: Comma separated. Add Urdu and Roman-Urdu names, e.g. doodh, dodh.
productForm.openingStockDesc: Set once at creation. After that, stock is managed on the Inventory screen.
productForm.lowStockAtHint: The product is flagged as running low at or below this number.
productForm.availableHint: Turning this off removes the product from the customer catalogue immediately.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: The order here is the order shoppers see.
categories.none: No categories yet. Create the first one to start building the catalogue.

categoryForm.basicsDesc: How this category appears to shoppers.
categoryForm.name: Name
categoryForm.descriptionHint: Optional. One or two lines shown at the top of the category page.
categoryForm.hasChildren_one: This category has 1 subcategory, so it stays at the top level.
categoryForm.hasChildren_other: This category has {count} subcategories, so it stays at the top level.
categoryForm.parentPlaceholder: None — this is a top-level category
categoryForm.iconHint: Shown on the category tile when there is no image.
categoryForm.imageUrlHint: Optional. Used instead of the icon once image hosting is configured.
categoryForm.placementDesc: Lower numbers appear first in the customer catalogue.
categoryForm.visibleHint: Turning this off hides the category and all of its subcategories.

combobox.willCreate: “{name}” will be created when you save, and will appear to shoppers.

uploader.upTo: JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to {count} more
uploader.shrinkNote: Large photos are shrunk automatically before uploading, so a picture straight from a phone camera is fine.
uploader.failed: That photo could not be uploaded. Please check your connection and try again.
uploader.none: No photos yet. A product without one still sells — it shows a tile with its initials instead.
uploader.altPlaceholder: e.g. 1 litre carton of Olper's full cream milk
uploader.altHint: Read aloud to shoppers using a screen reader. Required.
uploader.mainPhoto: Main photo — shown on cards and in search

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.searchPlaceholder: Search by product name or item code
inventory.emptyLow: Nothing is running low right now.
inventory.emptyNone: No stock records match that search.

delivery.title: Delivery pricing
delivery.upTo: Distance bands for deliveries up to {km} km
delivery.usedToPrice: Distance bands used to price every delivery
delivery.problemNote: A distance no band covers cannot be priced, and checkout refuses the order rather than inventing a fee.
delivery.problemOVERLAP: Two pricing bands cover some of the same distances.
delivery.problemGAP: There is a distance range that no pricing band covers.
delivery.problemEMPTY: There are no pricing bands in use.
delivery.emptyBody: Without at least one active band, no delivery can be priced and checkout will refuse every delivery order.
delivery.caption: Delivery pricing bands. Each band covers distances from its lower bound up to, but not including, its upper bound.

ruleDialog.description: Changes apply to future orders. Orders already placed keep the fee they were charged.
ruleDialog.label: Band name
ruleDialog.labelHint: Staff only — shoppers never see this. For example: Nearby, Across town.
ruleDialog.toHint: Not included — the next band starts here
ruleDialog.inUseHint: Only bands that are in use are considered when pricing a delivery.
ruleDialog.errLabel: Give this band a name staff will recognise
ruleDialog.errFrom: Enter a distance of 0 km or more
ruleDialog.errToOrder: The upper distance must be greater than the lower one
ruleDialog.errFee: Enter a whole fee between Rs. 0 and Rs. {max}

audit.description: Administrative changes across the platform, newest first.
